answer: A concrete defense is a story-pool challenge: each epoch a VRF draws one fable from a public garden of fresh narratives, and every identity must answer three questions on it within 120 seconds, signed. The pool rotates on a timed delta of one hour, so answers cannot be precomputed or cached; a template farm fails because each fable is unseen. Each identity burns 0.02 GPU-hours of real inference per round, so k clones pay k times that cost every epoch - linear, not log(n). No fable repeats within 180 days, and the payout contract itself voids a failed identity's epoch reward.
